title: A deep learning method for nanoparticle size measurement in SEM images
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20211-20219
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03210E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tingwang Tao, Haining Ji, Bin Liu
An improved U-Net model based on attention mechanisms and residual networks is proposed, combined with an automatic scalebar recognition algorithm, to enable accurate nanoparticle size measurement.
